message:
## Vulnerability Digest

One new relevant vulnerability was verified in the last 24 hours through the mandatory MongoDB ecosystem sweep. No separate new vulnerability was credibly matched to a component in the assigned DLL list.

**Scope:** `DLL_software_component.txt` only. `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` were not read or combined.

**Scan window:** 2026-10-21 07:40 UTC through 2026-10-22 07:40 UTC (2026-10-21 13:10 IST through 2026-10-22 13:10 IST).

### Finding 1: MongoDB Compass arbitrary code execution

- **Affected product/component:** MongoDB Compass 1.7.0 through versions before 1.49.15
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-113870, Improper Encoding of Server-Supplied JavaScript Values in MongoDB Compass BSON Parsing
- **Severity:** High; CVSS v3.1 8.8 (MongoDB)
- **Description:** Compass improperly escapes certain BSON values when converting a stored view's aggregation pipeline into editable source. Opening a specially crafted stored view for editing can execute arbitrary code with the privileges of the user running Compass.
- **Relevance:** MongoDB Compass is an official MongoDB ecosystem component covered by the mandatory sweep. MongoDB published the CVE at 2026-10-21 18:04 UTC, inside this run's 24-hour window.
- **Sources:** [CVE Program record](https://github.com/CVEProject/cvelistV5/blob/main/cves/2026/113xxx/CVE-2026-113870.json), [MongoDB Compass release notes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/release-notes/#mongodb-compass-14915)

### DLL component results

No other credible vulnerability newly reported or materially updated in the scan window could be tied confidently to a component and version in the normalized DLL list. Similar-name but unrelated products, including WordPress plugins carrying vendor-like names, were excluded.

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations and maintained libraries, MongoDB-owned notices, CVE records, GitHub security sources, and CISA sources. CVE-2026-113870 was the only credible MongoDB-family finding published or materially updated in the window.

### Review priority

Prompt review is recommended for MongoDB Compass installations below 1.49.15. No immediate action is indicated by this scan for the DLL-list components because no separate in-window findings passed freshness, relevance, and source-quality checks.
